_comment: docs/13 rule (2026-10-06): every published package has ONE build number on all six subdirs. `release` = the number every subdir must carry; `hotfixes` = declared per-subdir rebuilds between releases (also listed in docs/14); `next_release` = the numbers the next release (zig 0.17 wave or upstream-zig switch) will use. `retain` = {version: {package: [builds]}}: release builds a published consumer pins exactly (r-zig-toolchain 23.1.1 5/6/10, 2026-10-07; r-zig-pixi's lock 23.1.1 6/7/11); prune-universe.py never deletes them, even after a newer release or version (consumer contract, docs/14; keyed by version since the 23.1.5 release, 2026-11-11). Remove an entry only when no published consumer pins it any more.
